name: Enterprise Testing, Verification and Defect
constraints: WM-SFT-015 owns Test Specification, Test Run, result adjudication and Verification Evidence after removal of the incorrect WM-ACT-038 parent.
Test Result is an adjudicated outcome attached to one Test Run and does not create a second mastered root.
Defect, Requirement, remediation Task and tested Build or Release remain in their respective masters.
Expected behavior, oracle, comparator, tolerances and masking belong to the pinned specification revision; executable scripts remain external bindings.
Observation and verdict remain distinct; pass requires an evaluated expectation with attributable assertor and mode.
Product defect verification requires evidence against a different subject digest from the failing one; test repair alone never advances the product defect.
